experiment_governance.hypothesis: A case-isolated supervisor that sees only visible evaluator findings, immutable raw outputs and the same case-local blind Evidence Pack can remove material financial, numeric and citation errors while improving counterevidence and scenario calibration without hidden-Gold leakage.
experiment_governance.decision_target: Measure supervised recoverability separately from autonomous raw capability; no case may be cherry-picked and no successful case can mask another case's failure.
experiment_governance.baseline: the three immutable S2-05 raw candidates under evaluator v1.4
experiment_governance.ceiling: The supervisor cannot add external evidence in Experiment A; unsupported research gaps must remain typed gaps or explicit evidence requests.
stop_conditions: hidden Gold or another case's raw/corrections enter any model-visible request
a shared contract, identity, capture, auth, transport or corrected-run materialization defect is found
capacity or USD hard limits cannot contain one planner plus the bounded corrected-node closure
raw output or historical correction boundary would be rewritten

selected_protocol.campaign_semantics: one frozen protocol_three physically isolated case executions_aggregate attribution only after all terminal results
selected_protocol.supervisor_role: produce a typed correction plan, not a replacement report and not new financial facts
supervisor_visible_inputs: case-local evaluator v1.4 findings with code severity node_ref path and visible offending surface
case-local frozen blind Evidence Numeric and Gap aliases
typed allowed correction actions and dependency closure
supervisor_forbidden_inputs: evaluator-only hidden Gold targets or expected thesis
Codex Gold narrative or score explanations
another case's raw output findings correction plan or corrected candidate
external retrieval results not present in the frozen Experiment A pack

per_case: corrected candidate has a fresh identity and complete capture lineage
evaluator v1.4 L1 equals 0 and L2 equals 0
no cross-case ID unknown numeric or citation-role failure
all prior explicit_counterevidence_surface_empty findings are repaired with case-local counterevidence or an explicit no-evidence justification
all retained scenario or valuation thresholds are evidence/time-window/source-route calibrated or remain explicitly non-factual typed requests
Verifier explicitly detects or confirms repair of every prior material finding class
hidden scoring runs only after corrected candidate freeze
campaign: all three cases execute under the byte-equivalent protocol family with case-local substitutions only
all three raw candidates and boundaries remain immutable
all three corrected terminal results are preserved including failures
aggregate conclusion reports autonomous raw and supervised recoverability separately

supervised_recoverability_labels.proven: all three cases pass every per-case gate
supervised_recoverability_labels.partial: at least one but not all cases pass; failed cases remain explicit
supervised_recoverability_labels.not_proven: no case passes or a shared project-owned execution defect prevents valid measurement

owned_blockers_before_issuance.evidence: current boundaries reuse CORR-001 style identifiers and do not compile one model-visible correction-plan schema
writer_cross_case_unknown_or_wrong_id_role, writer_case_pack_coverage_incomplete and specialist_assigned_pack_coverage_incomplete currently fall through to typed_manual_disposition_required
the repository materializes correction ledgers but has no exact-once runner that reruns affected originating nodes and deterministically recomputes every dependent downstream node
raw evaluation and boundary materialization exist, but corrected-candidate identity, capture-first terminalization and hidden-score-after-freeze are not implemented as one governed path

required_outputs: single-source typed SupervisorPlan prompt schema validator fake and failure descriptors
case-qualified correction IDs and explicit owner/action for every current finding class
dependency-aware affected-node closure and fresh corrected-run identity
capture-first corrected terminal result and immutable raw bindings
DELL MU NVDA full-fake plus cross-case hidden-Gold numeric citation dependency and capacity mutations
fresh zero-call proof and a separate later admission decision

known_boundary: This decision freezes a fair supervised-recoverability experiment and identifies the shared project-owned prerequisites. It is not the implementation, admission, Provider execution, corrected candidate, formal score, product acceptance or release proof.
